fixture: webgl-triangle






NO WEBGL CONTEXT






Vertex colours are pure primaries at the three clip-space corners, so the barycentric
interpolation makes the centre pixel a predictable mid grey-ish blend. The assertion is
deliberately loose on the exact blend and strict on the thing that matters:
readPixels at the triangle centroid must not be the clear colour.




The renderer string comes from WEBGL_debug_renderer_info, which Chromium may
withhold. A null there is not a failure — it is a fact to record.
